title: Field Support Engineer
description:
Tipo de contrato: A definir

Descrição:
Cargo Field Support Engineer Indústria TIC / Telecomunicações Número de vagas 2 Descrição da função * At least 4 years of experience in similar position * RedHat or other Linux administration experience (CentOS/RedHat, command line, Bash, VIM, SSH) * Microsoft Windows Server experience, 2010 onwards * VMware configuration and administration (installation, configuration management, troubleshooting) * DBA (MongoDB) with extensive/advanced expertise: database design, administration, High Availability, performance/query tuning, backup & recovery * Dynatrace configuration and maintenance * F5 (Big-IP load balancer) configuration and administration

Requisitos:
Titulação mínima Licenciatura Experiência exigida 4 Anos Nacionalidade Não definido Línguas Português, Inglês Area funcional * Consultoria de IT * Informática e TI * Redes / Sistemas Competências * Engenharia de telecomunicações * Gestão de redes, Wifi * Redes Informáticas Aptidões necessárias * Linux systems administration (CentOS, RedHat) * Automation/configuration management tools: Salt, Puppet, Chef, Ansible * Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm; CI/CD in cloud environments * Kubernetes Administration, Docker, Harbor, Ingress-controller, Helm * ForgeRock, Cert Manager, Hashicorp Vault, Terraform * EFK stack (Elastic, Fluentd, Kibana), Apache ActiveMQ * HAProxy, Confluent/Kafka, RabbitMQ * Oracle DB, MySQL, MongoDB * JIRA, GitLab, Sonar, Jenkins, Openstack, Websphere MQ * Scripting: Python, Perl, Ruby, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, YAML * REST Webservices * Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer certification
